item_name: Rothco Bio-hazard Vintage Canvas Messenger Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco has taken our classic canvas messenger bag and added a zombie twist. The shoulder bag features a neon green bio-hazard symbol on the front flap with a detachable shoulder strap. The bag is perfect for fighting off a pack of zombies or carrying your school books.
